description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

description.zh: 要查询的防护对象，多个防护对象用英文逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The protected objects to query. Separate multiple protected objects with commas (,).

title.zh: 查询防护对象日志状态
title.en: Query log status of protected objects

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-resource-log-status --instance-id waf-cn-zz11zcl0000 --resources alb-wewbb23dfsetetcic1242-00000,alb-wewbb23dfsetetcic1242-10000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
